translations.literal: promoted through the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns: *Consort Chang, of the Hesheli clan, advanced from Lady of Attendance;
translations.idiomatic: promoted through the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns: Consort Chang, of the Hesheli clan, advanced from Lady of Attendance;

sentences.zh: 順嬪，失其氏，以常在進封。

translations.literal: Dame Shun, her clan unknown, advanced from Lady of the Presence.
translations.idiomatic: Dame Shun, her clan unknown, advanced from Lady of the Presence.

sentences.zh: *恆嬪，蔡佳氏；

translations.literal: *Dame Heng, of the Caijia clan;
translations.idiomatic: Dame Heng, of the Caijia clan;

sentences.zh: 豫妃，尚佳氏；

translations.literal: Consort Yu, of the Shangjia clan;
translations.idiomatic: Consort Yu, of the Shangjia clan;

sentences.zh: 貴人李氏，那氏：以答應進封。

translations.literal: Lady of Attendance Li and Lady Na: advanced from Lady-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Lady of Attendance Li and Lady Na: advanced from Lady-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 文宗孝德顯皇后，薩克達氏，太常寺少卿富泰女。

translations.literal: Empress Xiaode Xian of Wenzong, of the Sakda clan, was the daughter of Futai, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaode Xian of Wenzong, of the Sakda clan, was the daughter of Futai, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 文宗為皇子，，宣宗冊后為嫡福晉。

translations.literal: While Wenzong was still a prince, Xuanzong invested {empress} as primary fujin.
translations.idiomatic: While Wenzong was still a prince, Xuanzong invested {her} as primary fujin.

sentences.zh: 二十九年十二月乙亥，薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month on yihai day of the twenty-ninth year she died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yihai day of the twenty-ninth year, she died.

sentences.zh: 文宗即位，追冊諡曰孝德皇后。

translations.literal: When Wenzong acceded to the throne, she was posthumously invested and given the posthumous title Empress Xiaode.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenzong acceded to the throne, she was posthumously invested and titled Empress Xiaode.

sentences.zh: 權攢田村，同治初，移靜安莊，旋葬定陵，上諡。

translations.literal: She was provisionally interred at Tiancun Village; early in Tongzhi she was moved to Jing'an Village, then soon buried at the Ding Mausoleum, and the sovereign conferred a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: She was provisionally interred at Tiancun Village; early in Tongzhi she was moved to Jing'an Village, then buried at the Ding Mausoleum, and the emperor conferred a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 光緒、宣統屢加諡，曰孝德溫惠誠順慈莊恪慎徽懿恭天贊聖顯皇后。

translations.literal: Under Guangxu and Xuantong additional honorifics were repeatedly added, so that she was called Empress Xiaode Wenhui Chengshun Cizhuang Keshen Huiyi Gongtian Zansheng Xian.
translations.idiomatic: Under Guangxu and Xuantong further honorifics were added until she was styled Empress Xiaode Wenhui Chengshun Cizhuang Keshen Huiyi Gongtian Zansheng Xian.

sentences.zh: 孝貞顯皇后，鈕祜祿氏，廣西右江道穆揚阿女。

translations.literal: Empress Xiaozhen Xian, of the Niohuru clan, was the daughter of Muyang'a, Intendant of the Right River Circuit in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaozhen Xian, of the Niohuru clan, was the daughter of Muyang'a, Intendant of the Right River Circuit in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 事文宗潛邸，

translations.literal: She attended Wenzong's princely household.
translations.idiomatic: She attended Wenzong's princely household.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，封貞嬪，進貞貴妃。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, she was enfeoffed as Dame Zhen and promoted to Imperial Consort Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng, she was made Dame Zhen and promoted to Imperial Consort Zhen.

sentences.zh: 立為皇后。

translations.literal: She was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: She was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 十年，從幸熱河。

translations.literal: In the tenth year she accompanied the court to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year she accompanied the court to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月，文宗崩，穆宗即位，尊為皇太后。

translations.literal: Seventh month of the eleventh year Wenzong died; Muzong acceded to the throne and honored her as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eleventh year Wenzong died; Muzong acceded to the throne and honored her as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 是時，孝欽、孝貞兩宮並尊，詔旨稱「母后皇太后」、「聖母皇太后」以別之。

translations.literal: At that time the two palaces of Xiaojin and Xiaozhen were honored together; edicts styled them "Empress Dowager the Mother" and "Empress Dowager the Sacred Mother" to distinguish them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the two palaces of Xiaojin and Xiaozhen were honored together; edicts styled them "Empress Dowager the Mother" and "Empress Dowager the Sacred Mother" to distinguish them.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉朔，上奉兩太后御養心殿，垂簾聽政，

translations.literal: On the first day of yiyou in the eleventh month the sovereign escorted the two empresses dowager to the Hall of Mental Cultivation to hold court behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of yiyou in the eleventh month the emperor escorted the two empresses dowager to the Hall of Mental Cultivation to hold court behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 同治八年，內監安得海出京，山東巡撫丁寶楨以聞，太后立命誅之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tongzhi, the eunuch An Dehai left the capital; Shandong Governor Ding Baozhen reported it, and the empress dowager immediately ordered his execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tongzhi, when the eunuch An Dehai left the capital, Shandong Governor Ding Baozhen reported it, and the empress dowager immediately ordered his execution.

sentences.zh: 十二年，歸政於穆宗。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year she returned government to Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year she returned government to Muzong.

sentences.zh: 十三年，穆宗崩，德宗即位，復聽政。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Muzong died; Dezong acceded to the throne, and she again held court.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Muzong died; Guangxu acceded to the throne, and she again held court.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年三月壬申，崩，年四十五，葬定陵東普祥峪，曰定東陵。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu, third month on renshen day she died, aged forty-five; she was buried at Puxiang Valley east of the Ding Mausoleum, called the Dingdong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Guangxu, in the third month, on renshen day, she died, aged forty-five; she was buried at Puxiang Valley east of the Ding Mausoleum, at what is called the Dingdong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 初尊為皇太后，上徽號。

translations.literal: When she was first honored as empress dowager, honorific titles were conferred upon her.
translations.idiomatic: When she was first honored as empress dowager, the court conferred honorific titles upon her.

sentences.zh: 國有慶，累加上，曰慈安端康裕慶昭和莊敬皇太后。

translations.literal: Whenever the state had a celebration, titles were repeatedly added, so that she was called Grand Empress Dowager Ci'an Duankang Yuqing Zhaohe Zhuangjing.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the state had cause for celebration, further titles were added until she was styled Grand Empress Dowager Ci'an Duankang Yuqing Zhaohe Zhuangjing.

sentences.zh: 及崩，上諡。

translations.literal: Upon her death the sovereign conferred a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: After her death the emperor conferred a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 宣統加諡，曰孝貞慈安裕慶和敬誠靖儀天祚聖顯皇后。

translations.literal: Under Xuantong additional honorifics were added, so that she was called Empress Xiaozhen Ci'an Yuqing Hejing Chengjing Yitian Zuo Sheng Xian.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xuantong further honorifics were added, and she was styled Empress Xiaozhen Ci'an Yuqing Hejing Chengjing Yitian Zuo Sheng Xian.

sentences.zh: 孝欽顯皇后，葉赫那拉氏，安徽徽寧池廣太道惠徵女。

translations.literal: Empress Xiaoqin Xian, of the Yehe Nara clan, was the daughter of Huizheng, Circuit Intendant of Huining-Chiguang-Tai in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaoqin Xian, of the Yehe Nara clan, was the daughter of Huizheng, Circuit Intendant of Huining-Chiguang-Tai in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，后被選入宮，號懿貴人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng she was selected to enter the palace and was styled Lady Yi of Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 she was selected to enter the palace and styled Lady Yi of Attendance.

sentences.zh: 四年，封懿嬪。

translations.literal: In the fourth year she was enfeoffed as Dame Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year she was made Dame Yi.

sentences.zh: 六年三月庚辰，穆宗生，進懿妃。

translations.literal: Sixth month on gengchen day of the sixth year Muzong was born; she was promoted to Consort Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen day of the sixth year, Muzong was born, and she was promoted to Consort Yi.

sentences.zh: 七年，進懿貴妃。

translations.literal: In the seventh year she was promoted to Imperial Consort Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year she was promoted to Imperial Consort Yi.

sentences.zh: 十年，從幸熱河。

translations.literal: In the tenth year she accompanied the court to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year she accompanied the court to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月，文宗崩，穆宗即位，與孝貞皇后並尊為皇太后。

translations.literal: Seventh month of the eleventh year Wenzong died; Muzong acceded to the throne, and she was honored together with Empress Xiaozhen as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eleventh year Wenzong died; Muzong acceded to the throne, and she was honored together with Empress Xiaozhen as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 是時，怡親王載垣、鄭親王端華、協辦大學士尚書肅順等以文宗遺命，稱「贊襄政務王大臣」，擅政，兩太后患之。

translations.literal: At that time Prince Yi Zaiyuan, Prince Zheng Duhua, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister Sushun, and others, citing Wenzong's deathbed command, styled themselves "Princes and Ministers Assisting in Government" and monopolized power; the two empresses dowager were troubled by this.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Prince Yi Zaiyuan, Prince Zheng Duhua, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister Sushun, and others, citing Wenzong's deathbed command, styled themselves "Princes and Ministers Assisting in Government" and monopolized power; the two empresses dowager were troubled by this.

sentences.zh: 御史董元醇請兩太后權理朝政，兩太后召載垣等入議，載垣等以本朝未有皇太后垂簾，難之。

translations.literal: Censor Dong Yuanchun asked the two empresses dowager to manage court affairs on a provisional basis; the two empresses dowager summoned Zaiyuan and the others to discuss it, but Zaiyuan and the others objected that this dynasty had never had an empress dowager hold court behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Dong Yuanchun asked the two empresses dowager to manage court affairs provisionally; they summoned Zaiyuan and the others to discuss it, but Zaiyuan and his allies objected that the dynasty had never had an empress dowager hold court behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 侍郎勝保及大學士賈楨等疏繼至。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Shengbao and Grand Secretary Jia Zhen and others sent memorials in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Shengbao, Grand Secretary Jia Zhen, and others sent memorials in succession.

sentences.zh: 恭親王奕訢留守京師，聞喪奔赴，兩太后為言載垣等擅政狀。

translations.literal: Prince Gong Yi Xin remained at the capital; hearing of the mourning he rushed to join the funeral train, and the two empresses dowager told him of how Zaiyuan and the others had monopolized power.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong Yi Xin had remained at the capital; hearing of the mourning he rushed to join the funeral train, and the two empresses dowager told him how Zaiyuan and the others had monopolized power.

sentences.zh: 九月，奉文宗喪還京師，即下詔罪載垣、端華、肅順，皆至死，並罷黜諸大臣預贊襄政務者。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, after escorting Wenzong's coffin back to the capital, an edict immediately condemned Zaiyuan, Duhua, and Sushun, all to death, and dismissed all the ministers who had participated in assisting government.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, after escorting Wenzong's coffin back to the capital, an edict immediately condemned Zaiyuan, Duhua, and Sushun to death and dismissed all the ministers who had participated in assisting government.

sentences.zh: 授奕訢議政王，以上旨命王大臣條上垂簾典禮。

translations.literal: Yi Xin was appointed Prince Regent, and by imperial command the princes and ministers were ordered to submit in detail the rites for holding court behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Xin was appointed Prince Regent, and by imperial command the princes and ministers were ordered to submit in detail the rites for holding court behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉朔，上奉兩太后御養心殿，垂簾聽政。

translations.literal: On the first day of yiyou in the eleventh month the sovereign escorted the two empresses dowager to the Hall of Mental Cultivation to hold court behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of yiyou in the eleventh month the emperor escorted the two empresses dowager to the Hall of Mental Cultivation to hold court behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「垂簾非所樂爲，惟以時事多艱，王大臣等不能無所禀承，是以姑允所請。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Holding court behind the curtain is not what we take pleasure in; only because affairs are so difficult and the princes and ministers cannot be left without someone to report to have we provisionally granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Holding court behind the curtain is not what we take pleasure in; only because affairs are so difficult and the princes and ministers cannot be left without someone to report to have we provisionally granted the request.

sentences.zh: 俟皇帝典學有成，即行歸政。」

translations.literal: When the emperor has completed his classical studies, government will at once be returned to him."
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor has completed his classical studies, government will at once be returned to him."

sentences.zh: 自是，日召議政王、軍機大臣同入對。

translations.literal: Thereafter the Prince Regent and the Grand Councilors were summoned daily to audience together.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Prince Regent and the Grand Councilors were summoned daily to audience together.

sentences.zh: 內外章奏，兩太后覽訖，王大臣擬旨，翌日進呈。

translations.literal: Memorials from within and without the court were read by the two empresses dowager; the princes and ministers drafted rescripts, which were presented the next day.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials from within and without the court were read by the two empresses dowager; the princes and ministers drafted rescripts, which were presented the next day.

sentences.zh: 閱定，兩太后以文宗賜同道堂小璽鈐識，仍以上旨頒示。

translations.literal: After review the two empresses dowager affixed the small seal of the Tongdao Hall granted by Wenzong, and the rescripts were still promulgated as imperial commands.
translations.idiomatic: After review the two empresses dowager affixed the small seal of the Tongdao Hall granted by Wenzong, and the rescripts were still promulgated as imperial commands.

sentences.zh: 旋用御史徐啟文奏，令中外臣工於時事闕失，直言無隱；

translations.literal: Soon, acting on Censor Xu Qiwen's memorial, officials within and without the court were ordered to speak frankly without concealment concerning current shortcomings;
translations.idiomatic: Soon, acting on Censor Xu Qiwen's memorial, officials within and without the court were ordered to speak frankly without concealment concerning current shortcomings;

sentences.zh: 用御史鍾佩賢奏，諭崇節儉，重名器；

translations.literal: acting on Censor Zhong Peixian's memorial, an edict urged frugality and respect for ranks and honors;
translations.idiomatic: acting on Censor Zhong Peixian's memorial, an edict urged frugality and respect for ranks and honors;

sentences.zh: 用御史卞寶第奏，諭嚴賞罰，肅吏治，慎薦舉。

translations.literal: and acting on Censor Bian Baodi's memorial, an edict urged strict rewards and punishments, rectification of official discipline, and careful recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: and acting on Censor Bian Baodi's memorial, an edict urged strict rewards and punishments, rectification of official discipline, and careful recommendations.

sentences.zh: 命內直翰林輯前史帝王政治及母后垂簾事跡，可為法戒者，以進。

translations.literal: Hanlin academicians on palace duty were ordered to compile from earlier histories examples of imperial governance and of empresses dowager holding court behind the curtain that could serve as models or warnings, and submit them.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academicians on palace duty were ordered to compile from earlier histories examples of imperial governance and of empresses dowager holding court behind the curtain that could serve as models or warnings, and submit them.

sentences.zh: 同治初，寇亂未弭，兵連不解，兩太后同心求治，登進老成，倚任將帥，粵、捻蕩平，滇、隴漸定。

translations.literal: Early in Tongzhi the bandit turmoil had not yet been quelled and warfare continued unabated; the two empresses dowager sought good government with one mind, advanced seasoned men, relied on generals, and the Yue and Nian rebels were swept away while Yunnan and Gansu were gradually pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tongzhi bandit turmoil had not yet been quelled and warfare continued unabated; the two empresses dowager sought good government with one mind, advanced seasoned men, relied on generals, and the Yue and Nian rebels were swept away while Yunnan and Gansu were gradually pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月，歸政於穆宗。

translations.literal: Second month of the twelfth year she returned government to Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twelfth year she returned government to Muzong.

sentences.zh: 十三年十二月，穆宗崩，太后定策立德宗，兩太后復垂簾聽政。

translations.literal: Twelfth month of the thirteenth year Muzong died; the empress dowager decided policy and installed Dezong, and the two empresses dowager again held court behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirteenth year Muzong died; the empress dowager decided policy and installed Guangxu, and the two empresses dowager again held court behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「今皇帝紹承大統，尚在沖齡，時事艱難，不得已垂簾聽政。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The present emperor has succeeded to the great succession and is still of tender years; affairs are difficult, and holding court behind the curtain is unavoidable.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "The present emperor has succeeded to the great succession and is still of tender years; affairs are difficult, and holding court behind the curtain is unavoidable.

sentences.zh: 萬幾綜理，宵旰不遑，矧當民生多蹙，各省水旱頻仍。

translations.literal: The myriad affairs must be managed comprehensively, leaving no leisure from dawn to dusk, all the more when the people's livelihood is strained and floods and droughts recur in the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The myriad affairs must be managed comprehensively, leaving no leisure from dawn to dusk, all the more when the people's livelihood is strained and floods and droughts recur in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 中外臣工、九卿、科道有言事之責者，於用人行政，凡諸政事當舉，與時事有裨而又實能見施行者，詳細敷奏。

translations.literal: Officials within and without the court, the Nine Ministers, and the censorate with their duty to speak on affairs should, regarding appointments and administration and all policies that ought to be undertaken, set forth in detail whatever would benefit current affairs and can truly be put into practice.
translations.idiomatic: Officials within and without the court, the Nine Ministers, and the censorate with their duty to speak on affairs should, regarding appointments and administration and all policies that ought to be undertaken, set forth in detail whatever would benefit current affairs and can truly be put into practice.

sentences.zh: 至敦節儉，袪浮華，宜始自宮中，耳目玩好，浮麗紛華，一切不得上進。」

translations.literal: As for practicing thrift and rejecting extravagance, this should begin in the palace; objects for amusement and ornament, gaudy and florid, must not in any case be presented."
translations.idiomatic: As for practicing thrift and rejecting extravagance, this should begin in the palace; objects for amusement and ornament, gaudy and florid, must not in any case be presented."

sentences.zh: 「封疆大吏，當勤求閭閻疾苦，加意撫恤；

translations.literal: "Frontier governors and territorial officials should diligently inquire into the hardships of the common people and give special care to relief;
translations.idiomatic: "Frontier governors and territorial officials should diligently inquire into the hardships of the common people and give special care to relief;

sentences.zh: 清訟獄，勤緝捕。

translations.literal: clear lawsuits and prisons, and diligently pursue arrests.
translations.idiomatic: clear lawsuits and prisons, and diligently pursue arrests.

sentences.zh: 辦賑積穀，飭有司實力奉行；

translations.literal: carry out famine relief and grain storage, and order local officials to enforce these in earnest;
translations.idiomatic: Carry out famine relief and grain storage, and order local officials to enforce these in earnest;

sentences.zh: 並當整飭營伍，修明武備，選任賢能牧令，與民休息。」

translations.literal: and they should also rectify the garrisons, improve military readiness, select capable magistrates, and let the people rest."
translations.idiomatic: and they should also rectify the garrisons, improve military readiness, select capable magistrates, and let the people rest."

sentences.zh: 用御史陳彝奏，黜南書房行走、侍講王慶祺；

translations.literal: Acting on Censor Chen Yi's memorial, Hanlin Bachelor and Lecturer Wang Qingqi was dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: Acting on Censor Chen Yi's memorial, Hanlin Bachelor and Lecturer Wang Qingqi was dismissed;

sentences.zh: 用御史孫鳳翔等奏，黜總管內務府大臣貴寶、文錫；

translations.literal: acting on Censor Sun Fengxiang and others' memorial, Supervising Ministers of the Imperial Household Department Guibao and Wenxi were dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: acting on Censor Sun Fengxiang and others' memorial, Supervising Ministers of the Imperial Household Department Guibao and Wenxi were dismissed;

sentences.zh: 又罪宮監之不法者，戍三人，杖四人。

translations.literal: and palace eunuchs who had violated the law were punished: three were sent into exile and four were beaten.
translations.idiomatic: and palace eunuchs who had violated the law were punished: three were sent into exile and four were beaten.

sentences.zh: 一時宮府整肅。

translations.literal: For a time the palace and government were brought into good order.
translations.idiomatic: For a time the palace and government were brought into good order.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，葬穆宗惠陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu Muzong was buried at the Hui Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5 Muzong was buried at the Hui Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 吏部主事吳可讀從上陵，自殺，留疏乞降明旨，以將來大統歸穆宗嗣子。

translations.literal: Section Director Wu Kedu of the Ministry of Personnel, accompanying the tomb visit, killed himself and left a memorial begging that a clear edict be issued that the future succession should return to Muzong's heir.
translations.idiomatic: Section Director Wu Kedu of the Ministry of Personnel, accompanying the tomb visit, killed himself and left a memorial begging that a clear edict be issued that the future succession should return to Muzong's heir.

sentences.zh: 下大臣王議奏，王大臣等請毋庸議，尚書徐桐等，侍讀學士寶廷、黃體芳，司業張之洞，御史李端棻，皆別疏陳所見。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the princes and ministers for deliberation and memorial; the princes and ministers asked that no deliberation be needed, but Ministers Xu Tong and others, Hanlin Readers Baoting and Huang Tifang, Vice Director of the Directorate Zhang Zhidong, and Censor Li Duansun each submitted separate memorials stating their views.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the princes and ministers for deliberation; they asked that no deliberation be needed, but Ministers Xu Tong and others, Hanlin Readers Baoting and Huang Tifang, Vice Director of the Directorate Zhang Zhidong, and Censor Li Duansun each submitted separate memorials stating their views.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「我朝未明定儲位，可讀所請，與家法不合。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Our dynasty has not fixed the heir apparent in advance; Kedu's request does not accord with dynastic law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Our dynasty has not fixed the heir apparent in advance; Kedu's request does not accord with dynastic law.

sentences.zh: 皇帝受穆宗付託，將來慎選元良，纘承統緒，其繼大統者為穆宗嗣子，守祖宗之成憲，示天下以無私，皇帝必能善體此意也。」

translations.literal: The emperor received Muzong's entrustment; in future he will carefully choose a worthy heir to continue the succession, and whoever succeeds to the great succession will be Muzong's heir, observing the established laws of the ancestors and showing the empire impartiality; the emperor will surely be able to grasp this intent well."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor received Muzong's entrustment; in future he will carefully choose a worthy heir to continue the succession, and whoever succeeds to the great succession will be Muzong's heir, observing the established laws of the ancestors and showing the empire impartiality; the emperor will surely be able to grasp this intent well."

sentences.zh: 六年，太后不豫，上命諸督撫薦醫治疾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the empress dowager was unwell; the sovereign ordered governors and governors-general to recommend physicians to treat her illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the empress dowager was unwell; the emperor ordered governors and governors-general to recommend physicians to treat her illness.

sentences.zh: 八年，疾愈。

translations.literal: In the eighth year her illness abated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year her illness abated.

sentences.zh: 孝貞皇后既崩，太后獨當國。

translations.literal: After Empress Xiaozhen died, the empress dowager alone directed the state.
translations.idiomatic: After Empress Xiaozhen died, the empress dowager alone directed the state.

sentences.zh: 十年，法蘭西侵越南。

translations.literal: In the tenth year France invaded Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year France invaded Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 太后責恭親王奕訢等因循貽誤，罷之，更用禮親王世鐸等；

translations.literal: The empress dowager blamed Prince Gong Yi Xin and others for procrastination and delay, dismissed them, and replaced them with Prince Li Shikuo and others;
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager blamed Prince Gong Yi Xin and others for procrastination and delay, dismissed them, and replaced them with Prince Li Shikuo and others;

sentences.zh: 並諭軍機處，遇緊要事件，與醇親王奕譞商辦。

translations.literal: and instructed the Grand Council that on urgent matters they should consult with Prince Chun Yi Huan.
translations.idiomatic: and instructed the Grand Council that on urgent matters they should consult with Prince Chun Yi Huan.

sentences.zh: 庶子盛昱、錫珍，御史趙爾巽各疏言醇親王不宜參豫機務，諭曰：「自垂簾以來，揆度時勢，不能不用親藩進參機務。

translations.literal: Sub-Reader Sheng Yu and Xizhen and Censor Zhao Erxun each memorialized that Prince Chun should not participate in confidential affairs; an edict stated: "Since holding court behind the curtain, judging the times and circumstances, it has been impossible not to employ princes of the blood in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sub-Reader Sheng Yu and Xizhen and Censor Zhao Erxun each memorialized that Prince Chun should not participate in confidential affairs; an edict stated: "Since holding court behind the curtain, judging the times and circumstances, it has been impossible not to employ princes of the blood in confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 諭令奕譞與軍機大臣會商事件，本專指軍國重事，非概令與聞。

translations.literal: The order for Yi Huan to consult with the Grand Councilors on affairs was originally limited to important military and state matters, not a general command to hear of everything.
translations.idiomatic: The order for Yi Huan to consult with the Grand Councilors on affairs was originally limited to important military and state matters, not a general command to hear of everything.

sentences.zh: 奕譞再四懇辭，諭以俟皇帝親政，再降諭旨，始暫時奉命。

translations.literal: Yi Huan repeatedly begged to decline; he was instructed that when the emperor personally took government a further edict would be issued, and only then did he temporarily accept the command.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Huan repeatedly begged to decline; he was instructed that when the emperor personally took government a further edict would be issued, and only then did he temporarily accept the command.

sentences.zh: 此中委曲，諸臣不能盡知也。」

translations.literal: The full circumstances here cannot be completely known by the ministers."
translations.idiomatic: The full circumstances here cannot be completely known by the ministers."

sentences.zh: 是年，太后五十萬壽。

translations.literal: That year was the empress dowager's fiftieth birthday celebration.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the empress dowager's fiftieth birthday celebration.

sentences.zh: 十一年，法蘭西約定。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the treaty with France was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the treaty with France was concluded.

sentences.zh: 醇親王奕譞建議設海軍。

translations.literal: Prince Chun Yi Huan proposed establishing a navy.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chun Yi Huan proposed establishing a navy.

sentences.zh: 十三年夏，命會同大學士、直隸總督李鴻章巡閱海口，遣太監李蓮英從。

translations.literal: Summer of the thirteenth year he was ordered, together with Grand Secretary and Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang, to inspect the coastal defenses, and Eunuch Li Lianying was sent to accompany them.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirteenth year he was ordered, together with Grand Secretary and Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang, to inspect the coastal defenses, and Eunuch Li Lianying was sent to accompany them.

sentences.zh: 蓮英侍太后，頗用事。

translations.literal: Lianying attended the empress dowager and wielded considerable influence.
translations.idiomatic: Lianying attended the empress dowager and wielded considerable influence.

sentences.zh: 御史朱一新以各直省水災，奏請修省，辭及蓮英。

translations.literal: Censor Zhu Yixin, citing floods in the provinces, memorialized asking for self-examination and repentance, and his language touched on Lianying.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhu Yixin, citing floods in the provinces, memorialized asking for self-examination and repentance, and his language touched on Lianying.

sentences.zh: 太后不懌，責一新覆奏。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was displeased and ordered Yixin to submit a follow-up memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was displeased and ordered Yixin to submit a follow-up memorial.

sentences.zh: 一新覆奏，言鴻章具舟迎王，王辭之，蓮英乘以行，遂使將吏迎者誤為王舟。

translations.literal: Yixin submitted a follow-up memorial saying that Hongzhang had prepared a boat to welcome the prince, but the prince declined; Lianying took advantage of this to travel along, causing the officers who came to welcome them to mistake the boat for the prince's.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin submitted a follow-up memorial saying that Hongzhang had prepared a boat to welcome the prince, but the prince declined; Lianying took advantage of this to travel along, causing the officers who came to welcome them to mistake the boat for the prince's.

sentences.zh: 太后詰王，王遂對曰：「無之。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager questioned the prince, and he replied: "There was none."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager questioned the prince, and he replied: "There was none."

sentences.zh: 遂黜一新。

translations.literal: Yixin was then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin was then dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太后命以次年正月歸政，醇親王奕譞及王大臣等奏請太后訓政數年，德宗亦力懇再三，太后乃許之。

translations.literal: The empress dowager ordered that government be returned in the first month of the following year; Prince Chun Yi Huan and the princes and ministers memorialized asking the empress dowager to continue tutelary rule for several years, and Dezong also earnestly pleaded again and again, whereupon the empress dowager consented.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ordered that government be returned in the first month of the following year; Prince Chun Yi Huan and the princes and ministers memorialized asking the empress dowager to continue tutelary rule for several years, and Guangxu also earnestly pleaded again and again, whereupon the empress dowager consented.

sentences.zh: 王大臣等條上訓政典禮，命如議行。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers submitted in detail the rites for tutelary rule, and an order was issued to carry them out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and ministers submitted in detail the rites for tutelary rule, and an order was issued to carry them out as proposed.

sentences.zh: 請上徽號，堅不許。

translations.literal: They asked to confer honorific titles upon her, but she firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to confer honorific titles upon her, but she firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 十五年，德宗行婚禮。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Dezong performed the marriage rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Guangxu performed the marriage rites.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，太后歸政。

translations.literal: Second month on jimao day the empress dowager returned government.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jimao day, the empress dowager returned government.

sentences.zh: 御史屠仁守疏請太后歸政後，仍披覽章奏，裁決施行。

translations.literal: Censor Tu Renshou memorialized asking that after the empress dowager returned government she should still review memorials and decide and implement them.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Tu Renshou memorialized asking that after the empress dowager returned government she should still review memorials and decide and implement them.

sentences.zh: 太后不可，諭曰：「垂簾聽政，本萬不得已之舉。

translations.literal: The empress dowager would not agree and issued an edict stating: "Holding court behind the curtain was originally a measure of last resort.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager would not agree and issued an edict stating: "Holding court behind the curtain was originally a measure of last resort.

sentences.zh: 深宮遠鑒前代流弊，特飭及時歸政。

translations.literal: From deep within the palace, looking far back at the abuses of earlier ages, I specially ordered the timely return of government.
translations.idiomatic: From deep within the palace, looking far back at the abuses of earlier ages, I specially ordered the timely return of government.

sentences.zh: 歸政後，惟醇親王單銜具奏，暫須徑達。

translations.literal: After the return of government, only Prince Chun may submit memorials under his own signature, which for the time being must be sent directly.
translations.idiomatic: After the return of government, only Prince Chun may submit memorials under his own signature, which for the time being must be sent directly.

sentences.zh: 醇親王密陳：『初裁大政，軍國重事，定省可以禀承。』

translations.literal: Prince Chun privately stated: 'At the beginning of assuming great affairs, on important military and state matters, morning and evening greetings may be used to report and receive instructions.'
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chun privately stated: 'At the beginning of assuming great affairs, on important military and state matters, morning and evening greetings may be used to report and receive instructions.'

sentences.zh: 並非著為典常，使訓政永無底止。」

translations.literal: This is not established as a permanent rule, making tutelary rule endless."
translations.idiomatic: This is not established as a permanent rule, making tutelary rule endless."

sentences.zh: 因斥仁守乖謬，奪官。

translations.literal: Renshou was therefore rebuked as perverse and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Renshou was therefore rebuked as perverse and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 同治間，穆宗議修圓明園，奉兩太后居之，事未行。

translations.literal: During Tongzhi Muzong proposed restoring the Old Summer Palace for the two empresses dowager to reside in, but the plan was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongzhi Muzong proposed restoring the Old Summer Palace for the two empresses dowager to reside in, but the plan was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 德宗以萬壽山大報恩延壽寺，高宗奉孝聖憲皇后三次祝釐於此，命葺治，備太后臨幸，並更清漪園為頤和園，太后許之。

translations.literal: Dezong, because Gaozong had thrice offered blessings for Empress Xiaosheng the Xian at the Great Bao'en Temple of Longevity on Longevity Hill, ordered it repaired for the empress dowager's visits, and also renamed the Qingyi Garden the Summer Palace; the empress dowager consented.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu, because Qianlong had thrice offered blessings for Empress Xiaosheng the Xian at the Great Bao'en Temple of Longevity on Longevity Hill, ordered it repaired for the empress dowager's visits, and also renamed the Qingyi Garden the Summer Palace; the empress dowager consented.

sentences.zh: 既歸政，奉太后駐焉。

translations.literal: After government was returned, he had the empress dowager take up residence there.
translations.idiomatic: After government was returned, he had the empress dowager take up residence there.

sentences.zh: 歲十月十日，太后萬壽節，上率王大臣祝嘏，以為常。

translations.literal: Each year on the tenth day of the tenth month, the empress dowager's birthday, the sovereign led the princes and ministers in offering congratulations, and this became customary.
translations.idiomatic: Each year on the tenth day of the tenth month, the empress dowager's birthday, the emperor led the princes and ministers in offering congratulations, and this became customary.

sentences.zh: 十六年，醇親王奕譞薨。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Prince Chun Yi Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Prince Chun Yi Huan died.

sentences.zh: 二十年，日本侵朝鮮，以太后命，起恭親王奕訢。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Japan invaded Korea; by the empress dowager's command Prince Gong Yi Xin was recalled to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Japan invaded Korea; by the empress dowager's command Prince Gong Yi Xin was recalled to office.

sentences.zh: 是年，太后六十萬壽，上請在頤和園受賀，仿康熙、乾隆間成例，自大內至園，蹕路所經，設彩棚經壇，舉行慶典。

translations.literal: That year was the empress dowager's sixtieth birthday; the sovereign asked to receive congratulations at the Summer Palace, following the precedents of the Kangxi and Qianlong reigns, and from the Forbidden City to the garden along the imperial route colored pavilions and scripture altars were set up to hold the celebration.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the empress dowager's sixtieth birthday; the emperor asked to receive congratulations at the Summer Palace, following the precedents of the Kangxi and Qianlong reigns, and from the Forbidden City to the garden along the imperial route colored pavilions and scripture altars were set up to hold the celebration.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮軍事急，以太后命罷之。

translations.literal: Because the Korean military situation was urgent, by the empress dowager's command it was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Korean military situation was urgent, by the empress dowager's command it was canceled.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，恭親王奕訢薨。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Prince Gong Yi Xin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Prince Gong Yi Xin died.

sentences.zh: 上事太后謹，朝廷大政，必請命乃行。

translations.literal: The sovereign served the empress dowager with care; on great affairs of court he always asked her command before acting.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor served the empress dowager with care; on great affairs of court he always asked her command before acting.

sentences.zh: 顧以國事日非，思變法救亡，太后意不謂然，積相左。

translations.literal: But because state affairs grew daily worse he thought to reform the laws to save the dynasty; the empress dowager did not agree, and over time they grew opposed.
translations.idiomatic: But because state affairs grew daily worse he thought to reform the laws to save the dynasty; the empress dowager did not agree, and over time they grew opposed.

sentences.zh: 上期以九月奉太后幸天津閱兵，訛言謂太后將勒兵廢上；

translations.literal: The sovereign had planned in the ninth month to escort the empress dowager to Tianjin to review troops; rumors said the empress dowager would mobilize troops to depose him;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had planned in the ninth month to escort the empress dowager to Tianjin to review troops; rumors said the empress dowager would mobilize troops to depose him;

sentences.zh: 又謂有謀圍頤和園劫太后者。

translations.literal: and others said there was a plot to surround the Summer Palace and seize the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: and others said there was a plot to surround the Summer Palace and seize the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，太后遽自頤和園還宮，復訓政。

translations.literal: Eighth month on dinghai day the empress dowager suddenly returned from the Summer Palace to the palace and resumed tutelary rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dinghai day, the empress dowager suddenly returned from the Summer Palace to the palace and resumed tutelary rule.

sentences.zh: 以上有疾，命居瀛臺養疴。

translations.literal: Because the sovereign was ill, he was ordered to convalesce on the Ying Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Because the emperor was ill, he was ordered to convalesce on the Ying Terrace.

sentences.zh: 二十五年十二月，立端郡王載漪子溥儁繼穆宗為皇子。

translations.literal: Twelfth month of the twenty-fifth year Prince Duan's son Zaiyi, Pujun, was installed as heir to Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twenty-fifth year Prince Duan's son Pujun was installed as heir to Muzong.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，義和拳事起，載漪等信其術，言於太后，謂為義民，縱令入京師，擊殺德意志使者克林德及日本使館書記，圍使館。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer affair arose; Zaiyi and others believed in their arts and told the empress dowager they were righteous people; they were allowed to enter the capital, killed the German minister Ketteler and a Japanese legation secretary, and besieged the legations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer affair arose; Zaiyi and others believed in their arts and told the empress dowager they were righteous people; they were allowed to enter the capital, killed the German minister Ketteler and a Japanese legation secretary, and besieged the legations.

sentences.zh: 德意志、奧大利亞、比利時、日斯巴尼亞、美利堅、法蘭西、英吉利、義大利、日本、和蘭、俄羅斯十國之師來侵。

translations.literal: Armies of ten powers—Germany, Austria, Belgium, Spain, the United States, France, Britain, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, and Russia—came to invade.
translations.idiomatic: Armies of ten powers—Germany, Austria, Belgium, Spain, the United States, France, Britain, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, and Russia—came to invade.

sentences.zh: 七月，逼京師。

translations.literal: Seventh month they pressed on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they pressed on the capital.

sentences.zh: 太后率上出自德勝門，道宣化、大同。

translations.literal: The empress dowager led the sovereign out through Desheng Gate, taking the route through Xuanhua and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager led the emperor out through Desheng Gate, taking the route through Xuanhua and Datong.

sentences.zh: 八月，駐太原。

translations.literal: Eighth month they halted at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they halted at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 九月，至西安。

translations.literal: Ninth month they reached Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month they reached Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 命慶親王奕劻、大學士總督李鴻章與各國議和。

translations.literal: Prince Qing Yi Kuang and Grand Secretary and Governor-General Li Hongzhang were ordered to negotiate peace with the various powers.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qing Yi Kuang and Grand Secretary and Governor-General Li Hongzhang were ordered to negotiate peace with the various powers.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，各國約成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year treaties with the various powers were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year treaties with the various powers were concluded.

sentences.zh: 八月，上奉太后發西安。

translations.literal: Eighth month the sovereign escorted the empress dowager and departed Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the emperor escorted the empress dowager and departed Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 十月，駐開封。

translations.literal: Tenth month they halted at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they halted at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 時端郡王載漪以庇義和拳得罪廢，溥儁以公銜出宮。

translations.literal: At that time Prince Duan Zaiyi was condemned and dismissed for shielding the Boxers, and Pujun left the palace with the rank of duke.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Prince Duan Zaiyi was condemned and dismissed for shielding the Boxers, and Pujun left the palace with the rank of duke.

sentences.zh: 十一月，還京師。

translations.literal: Eleventh month they returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 上仍居瀛臺養疴。

translations.literal: The sovereign still convalesced on the Ying Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor still convalesced on the Ying Terrace.

sentences.zh: 太后屢下詔：「母子一心，勵行新政。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager repeatedly issued edicts: "Mother and son are of one mind; vigorously carry out the new policies."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager repeatedly issued edicts: "Mother and son are of one mind; vigorously carry out the new policies."

sentences.zh: 三十二年七月，下詔預備立憲。

translations.literal: Seventh month of the thirty-second year an edict was issued to prepare constitutional government.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirty-second year an edict was issued to prepare constitutional government.

sentences.zh: 三十四年十月，太后有疾。

translations.literal: Tenth month of the thirty-fourth year the empress dowager fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the thirty-fourth year the empress dowager fell ill.

sentences.zh: 上疾益增劇。

translations.literal: The sovereign's illness grew much worse.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's illness grew much worse.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太后命授醇親王載灃攝政王。

translations.literal: On renshen day the empress dowager ordered Prince Chun Zaifeng appointed regent.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the empress dowager ordered Prince Chun Zaifeng appointed regent.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上崩於瀛台。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the sovereign died on the Ying Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the emperor died on the Ying Terrace.

sentences.zh: 太后定策立宣統皇帝，即日尊為太皇太后。

translations.literal: The empress dowager decided policy and installed the Xuantong emperor, and that same day was honored as grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager decided policy and installed the Xuantong emperor, and that same day was honored as grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太后崩，年七十四，葬定陵東普陀峪，曰定東陵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the empress dowager died, aged seventy-four; she was buried at Putuo Valley east of the Ding Mausoleum, called the Dingdong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the empress dowager died, aged seventy-four; she was buried at Putuo Valley east of the Ding Mausoleum, at what is called the Dingdong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 初尊爲皇太后，上徽號國有慶，累加上曰慈禧端佑康頤昭豫莊誠壽恭欽獻崇熙皇太后。

translations.literal: When she was first honored as empress dowager, honorific titles were conferred; whenever the state had a celebration titles were repeatedly added, so that she was called Grand Empress Dowager Cixi Duanyou Kangyi Zhaoyu Zhuangcheng Shougong Qinxian Chongxi.
translations.idiomatic: When she was first honored as empress dowager, honorific titles were conferred; whenever the state had cause for celebration further titles were added until she was styled Grand Empress Dowager Cixi Duanyou Kangyi Zhaoyu Zhuangcheng Shougong Qinxian Chongxi.

sentences.zh: 及崩，即以徽號爲諡。

translations.literal: Upon her death her honorific titles became her posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Upon her death her honorific titles became her posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 子一，穆宗。

translations.literal: Sons, one: Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: She bore one son, Muzong.

sentences.zh: 莊靜皇貴妃，他他拉氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Zhuangjing, of the Tatara clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Zhuangjing, of the Tatara clan.

sentences.zh: 事文宗，爲貴人，累進麗妃。

translations.literal: She attended Wenzong as Lady of Attendance and was repeatedly promoted to Consort Li.
translations.idiomatic: She attended Wenzong as Lady of Attendance and was promoted in stages to Consort Li.

sentences.zh: 穆宗尊封爲皇考麗皇貴太妃。

translations.literal: Muzong honored her as his father's Grand Imperial Noble Consort Li.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong honored her as his father's Grand Imperial Noble Consort Li.

sentences.zh: 薨，諡曰莊靜皇貴妃。

translations.literal: She died; her posthumous title was Imperial Noble Consort Zhuangjing.
translations.idiomatic: After her death she was posthumously titled Imperial Noble Consort Zhuangjing.

sentences.zh: 女一，下嫁符珍。

translations.literal: Daughters, one: married downward to Fu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: She bore one daughter, who married Fu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 玫貴妃，徐佳氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Consort Mei, of the Xujia clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Consort Mei, of the Xujia clan.

sentences.zh: 事文宗，爲貴人，進玫嬪。

translations.literal: She attended Wenzong as Lady of Attendance and was promoted to Dame Mei.
translations.idiomatic: She attended Wenzong as Lady of Attendance and was promoted to Dame Mei.

sentences.zh: 穆宗尊爲皇考玫貴妃。

translations.literal: Muzong honored her as his father's Imperial Consort Mei.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong honored her as his father's Imperial Consort Mei.

sentences.zh: 子一，未命名，殤。

translations.literal: Sons, one: unnamed, died in infancy.
translations.idiomatic: She bore one son, unnamed, who died in infancy.

sentences.zh: 端恪皇貴妃，佟佳氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Duanke, of the Tunggiya clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Duanke, of the Tunggiya clan.

sentences.zh: 事文宗，爲祺嬪。

translations.literal: She attended Wenzong as Dame Qi.
translations.idiomatic: She attended Wenzong as Dame Qi.

sentences.zh: 同治間尊爲皇考祺貴妃。

translations.literal: During Tongzhi she was honored as his father's Imperial Consort Qi.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongzhi she was honored as his father's Imperial Consort Qi.

sentences.zh: 宣統初，尊爲皇祖祺貴太妃。

translations.literal: Early in Xuantong she was honored as his grandfather's Grand Imperial Consort Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xuantong she was honored as his grandfather's Grand Imperial Consort Qi.

sentences.zh: 薨，諡曰端恪皇貴妃。

translations.literal: She died; her posthumous title was Imperial Noble Consort Duanke.
translations.idiomatic: After her death she was posthumously titled Imperial Noble Consort Duanke.

sentences.zh: 文宗諸妃，未有子女而同治、光緒兩朝尊封者，婉貴妃、璷妃、吉妃、禧妃、慶妃、雲嬪、英嬪、容嬪、璹嬪、玉嬪，皆自貴人進封。

translations.literal: Among Wenzong's consorts who had no children but received honored ranks in the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns were Imperial Consort Wan, Consort Lu, Consort Ji, Consort Xi, Consort Qing, Dame Yun, Dame Ying, Dame Rong, Dame Shu, and Dame Yu; all were advanced from Lady of Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Among Wenzong's consorts who had no children but received honored ranks in the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns were Imperial Consort Wan, Consort Lu, Consort Ji, Consort Xi, Consort Qing, Dame Yun, Dame Ying, Dame Rong, Dame Shu, and Dame Yu; all had risen from the rank of Lady of Attendance.

sentences.zh: 婉貴妃，索綽絡氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Consort Wan, of the Suochuoluo clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Consort Wan, of the Suochuoluo clan.

sentences.zh: 雲嬪，武佳氏。

translations.literal: Dame Yun, of the Wujia clan.
translations.idiomatic: Dame Yun, of the Wujia clan.

sentences.zh: 英嬪，伊爾根覺羅氏。

translations.literal: Dame Ying, of the Irgen Gioro clan.
translations.idiomatic: Dame Ying, of the Irgen Gioro clan.

sentences.zh: 餘不知氏族。

translations.literal: Of the rest the clans are unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Of the rest the clans are unknown.

sentences.zh: 孝哲毅皇后，阿魯特氏。

translations.literal: Empress Xiaozhe Yi, of the Arut clan.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaozhe Yi, of the Arut clan.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書崇綺女。

translations.literal: She was the daughter of Minister of Revenue Chongqi.
translations.idiomatic: She was the daughter of Minister of Revenue Chongqi.

sentences.zh: 同治十一年九月立爲皇后。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, ninth month she was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, in the ninth month she was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 十三年十二月，穆宗崩，德宗即位。

translations.literal: Twelfth month of the thirteenth year Muzong died and Dezong acceded to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirteenth year Muzong died and Guangxu acceded to the throne.

sentences.zh: 以兩太后命封爲嘉順皇后。

translations.literal: By command of the two empresses dowager she was enfeoffed as Empress Jiashun.
translations.idiomatic: By command of the two empresses dowager she was enfeoffed as Empress Jiashun.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年二月戊子崩，梓宮暫安隆福寺。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu, second month on wuzi day she died; her coffin was temporarily placed at Longfu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu, in the second month, on wuzi day, she died; her coffin was temporarily placed at Longfu Temple.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，御史潘敦儼因歲旱上言，請更定諡號，謂：「后崩在穆宗升遐百日內，道路傳聞，或稱傷悲致疾，或云絕粒霣生，奇節不彰，何以慰在天之靈？

translations.literal: Fifth month of the second year Censor Pan Dunyi, citing drought, memorialized asking that her posthumous title be revised, saying: "The empress died within the hundred days after Muzong's death; rumors in the streets say either that grief brought on illness or that she starved herself to death; if such extraordinary virtue is not made known, how can the spirit in Heaven be comforted?
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year Censor Pan Dunyi, citing drought, memorialized asking that her posthumous title be revised, saying: "The empress died within the hundred days after Muzong's death; rumors in the streets say either that grief brought on illness or that she starved herself to death; if such extraordinary virtue is not made known, how can the spirit in Heaven be comforted?

sentences.zh: 何以副兆民之望？」

translations.literal: How can the hopes of the myriad people be fulfilled?"
translations.idiomatic: How can the hopes of the myriad people be fulfilled?"

sentences.zh: 太后以其言無據，斥為謬妄，奪官。

translations.literal: The empress dowager, holding his words groundless, rebuked them as absurd and dismissed him from office.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager, holding his words groundless, rebuked them as absurd and dismissed him from office.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，合葬惠陵，上諡。

translations.literal: Third month of the fifth year she was buried together at the Hui Mausoleum, and the sovereign conferred a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year she was buried with him at the Hui Mausoleum, and the emperor conferred a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 宣統加諡，曰孝哲嘉順淑慎賢明恭端憲天彰聖毅皇后。

translations.literal: Under Xuantong additional honorifics were added, so that she was called Empress Xiaozhe Jiashun Shushen Xianming Gongduan Xiantian Zhangsheng Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xuantong further honorifics were added, and she was styled Empress Xiaozhe Jiashun Shushen Xianming Gongduan Xiantian Zhangsheng Yi.

sentences.zh: 淑慎皇貴妃，富察氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Shushen, of the Fuca clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Shushen, of the Fuca clan.

sentences.zh: 穆宗立后，同日封慧妃。

translations.literal: When Muzong installed the empress, on the same day {she} was enfeoffed as Consort Hui.
translations.idiomatic: When Muzong installed her as empress, on the same day she was made Consort Hui.

sentences.zh: 進皇貴妃。

translations.literal: She was promoted to Imperial Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: She was promoted to Imperial Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 德宗即位，以兩太后命，封為敦宜皇貴妃。

translations.literal: When Dezong acceded to the throne, by command of the two empresses dowager she was enfeoffed as Imperial Noble Consort Dunyi.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangxu acceded to the throne, by command of the two empresses dowager she was made Imperial Noble Consort Dunyi.

sentences.zh: 進敦宜榮慶皇貴妃，

translations.literal: She was promoted to Imperial Noble Consort Dunyi Rongqing.
translations.idiomatic: She was promoted to Imperial Noble Consort Dunyi Rongqing.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年，薨。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu, she died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu, she died.

sentences.zh: 諡曰淑慎皇貴妃。

translations.literal: Her posthumous title was Imperial Noble Consort Shushen.
translations.idiomatic: She was posthumously titled Imperial Noble Consort Shushen.

sentences.zh: 莊和皇貴妃，阿魯特氏，大學士賽尚阿女，孝哲毅皇后姑也。

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Zhuanghe, of the Arut clan, was the daughter of Grand Secretary Saishang'a and was an aunt of Empress Xiaozhe Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Zhuanghe, of the Arut clan, was the daughter of Grand Secretary Saishang'a and an aunt of Empress Xiaozhe Yi.

sentences.zh: 事穆宗，為珣嬪，進妃。

translations.literal: She attended Muzong as Dame Xun and was promoted to consort.
translations.idiomatic: She attended Muzong as Dame Xun and was promoted to consort.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，進貴妃。

translations.literal: During Guangxu she was promoted to Imperial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: During Guangxu she was promoted to Imperial Consort.

sentences.zh: 宣統皇帝尊為皇考珣皇貴妃。

translations.literal: The Xuantong emperor honored her as his father's Imperial Noble Consort Xun.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuantong emperor honored her as his father's Imperial Noble Consort Xun.

sentences.zh: 孝定景皇后崩未逾月，妃薨。

translations.literal: Less than a month after Empress Xiaoding Jing died, the consort died.
translations.idiomatic: Less than a month after Empress Xiaoding Jing died, the consort died.

sentences.zh: 諡曰莊和皇貴妃。

translations.literal: Her posthumous title was Imperial Noble Consort Zhuanghe.
translations.idiomatic: She was posthumously titled Imperial Noble Consort Zhuanghe.

sentences.zh: 敬懿皇貴妃，赫捨裡氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Jingyi, of the Hesheli clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Jingyi, of the Hesheli clan.

sentences.zh: 事穆宗，自嬪進妃。

translations.literal: She attended Muzong and was promoted from dame to consort.
translations.idiomatic: She attended Muzong and was promoted from dame to consort.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，進貴妃。

translations.literal: During Guangxu she was promoted to Imperial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: During Guangxu she was promoted to Imperial Consort.

sentences.zh: 宣統間，累進尊封。

translations.literal: During Xuantong she was repeatedly advanced in honored rank.
translations.idiomatic: During Xuantong she was repeatedly advanced in honored rank.

sentences.zh: 榮惠皇貴妃，西林覺羅氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Ronghui, of the Xilin Gioro clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Ronghui, of the Xilin Gioro clan.

sentences.zh: 事穆宗，自貴人進嬪。

translations.literal: She attended Muzong and was promoted from Lady of Attendance to dame.
translations.idiomatic: She attended Muzong and was promoted from Lady of Attendance to dame.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，進妃。

translations.literal: During Guangxu she was promoted to consort.
translations.idiomatic: During Guangxu she was promoted to consort.

sentences.zh: 宣統間，累進尊封。

translations.literal: During Xuantong she was repeatedly advanced in honored rank.
translations.idiomatic: During Xuantong she was repeatedly advanced in honored rank.

sentences.zh: 德宗孝定景皇后，葉赫那拉氏，都統桂祥女，孝欽顯皇后侄女也。

translations.literal: Empress Xiaoding Jing of Dezong, of the Yehe Nara clan, was the daughter of Commander-in-Chief Guixiang and was a niece of Empress Xiaoqin Xian.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaoding Jing of Guangxu, of the Yehe Nara clan, was the daughter of Commander-in-Chief Guixiang and a niece of Empress Xiaoqin Xian.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年十月，孝欽顯皇后為德宗聘焉。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, tenth month Empress Xiaoqin Xian arranged her betrothal to Dezong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, in the tenth month Empress Xiaoqin Xian arranged her betrothal to Guangxu.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，立為皇后。

translations.literal: First month of the fifteenth year she was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year she was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，從幸西安。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year she accompanied the court to Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year she accompanied the court to Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，還京師。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year they returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year they returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，宣統皇帝即位。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year the Xuantong emperor acceded to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year the Xuantong emperor acceded to the throne.

sentences.zh: 稱「兼祧母后」，尊為皇太后。

translations.literal: Styled "Empress Dowager of the Dual Succession," she was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Styled "Empress Dowager of the Dual Succession," she was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 上徽號曰隆裕。

translations.literal: The honorific title Longyu was conferred upon her.
translations.idiomatic: She was granted the honorific title Longyu.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年十二月戊午，以太后命遜位。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, twelfth month on wuwu day, by the empress dowager's command, she abdicated.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong, in the twelfth month, on wuwu day, by the empress dowager's command, she abdicated.

sentences.zh: 越二年正月甲戌，崩，年四十六。

translations.literal: Two years later, first month on jiaxu day, she died, aged forty-six.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, in the first month, on jiaxu day, she died, aged forty-six.

sentences.zh: 上諡，曰孝定隆裕寬惠慎哲協天保聖景皇后，合葬崇陵。

translations.literal: The sovereign conferred a posthumous title: Empress Xiaoding Longyu Kuanhui Shenzhe Xietian Baosheng Jing; she was buried together at the Chong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: She was posthumously titled Empress Xiaoding Longyu Kuanhui Shenzhe Xietian Baosheng Jing and buried with him at the Chong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 端康皇貴妃，他他拉氏，

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Duankang, of the Tatara clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Duankang, of the Tatara clan.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年，選為瑾嬪。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, she was selected as Dame Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, she was selected as Dame Jin.

sentences.zh: 二十年，進瑾妃。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year she was promoted to Consort Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year she was promoted to Consort Jin.

sentences.zh: 以女弟珍妃忤太后，同降貴人。

translations.literal: Because her younger sister Consort Zhen offended the empress dowager, both were demoted to Lady of Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Because her younger sister Consort Zhen offended the empress dowager, both were demoted to Lady of Attendance.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，仍封瑾妃。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year she was again enfeoffed as Consort Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year she was again made Consort Jin.

sentences.zh: 宣統初，尊為兼祧皇考瑾貴妃。

translations.literal: Early in Xuantong she was honored as his father's Imperial Consort Jin of the Dual Succession.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xuantong she was honored as his father's Imperial Consort Jin of the Dual Succession.

sentences.zh: 遜位後，進尊封。

translations.literal: After the abdication she was advanced in honored rank.
translations.idiomatic: After the abdication she was advanced in honored rank.

sentences.zh: 歲甲子，薨。

translations.literal: In the jiazi year she died.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiazi year she died.

sentences.zh: 恪順皇貴妃，他他拉氏，端康皇貴妃女弟。

translations.literal: Imperial Noble Consort Keshun, of the Tatara clan, was the younger sister of Imperial Noble Consort Duankang.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Noble Consort Keshun, of the Tatara clan, was the younger sister of Imperial Noble Consort Duankang.

sentences.zh: 同選，為珍嬪。

translations.literal: Selected together with her, she was made Dame Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Selected together with her sister, she was made Dame Zhen.

sentences.zh: 進珍妃。

translations.literal: She was promoted to Consort Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: She was promoted to Consort Zhen.

sentences.zh: 以忤太后，諭責其習尚奢華，屢有乞請，降貴人。

translations.literal: Because she offended the empress dowager, an edict rebuked her luxurious habits and repeated petitions, and she was demoted to Lady of Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Because she offended the empress dowager, an edict rebuked her luxurious habits and repeated petitions, and she was demoted to Lady of Attendance.

sentences.zh: 逾年，仍封珍妃。

translations.literal: After more than a year she was again enfeoffed as Consort Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year she was again made Consort Zhen.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，太后出巡，沈於井。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the empress dowager went on tour, she was drowned in a well.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, when the empress dowager went on tour, she was drowned in a well.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，上還京師。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the sovereign returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 追進皇貴妃。

translations.literal: She was posthumously advanced to Imperial Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: She was posthumously advanced to Imperial Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 葬西直門外，移祔崇陵。

translations.literal: She was buried outside Xizhi Gate and later moved to be enshrined at the Chong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: She was buried outside Xizhi Gate and later moved to be enshrined at the Chong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 追進尊封。

translations.literal: She was posthumously advanced in honored rank.
translations.idiomatic: She was posthumously advanced in honored rank.

sentences.zh: 宣統皇后，郭博勒氏，總管內務府大臣榮源女。

translations.literal: Empress of Xuantong, of the Gobulo clan, was the daughter of Supervising Minister of the Imperial Household Department Rongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Empress of Xuantong, of the Gobulo clan, was the daughter of Supervising Minister of the Imperial Household Department Rongyuan.

sentences.zh: 遜位後，歲壬戌，冊立為皇后。

translations.literal: After the abdication, in the renxu year, she was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: After the abdication, in the renxu year, she was invested as empress.

sentences.zh: 淑妃，額爾德特氏。

translations.literal: Imperial Consort Shu, of the Erdete clan.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Consort Shu, of the Erdete clan.

sentences.zh: 同日冊封。

translations.literal: On the same day she was invested and enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: On the same day she was invested and enfeoffed.
